findings.title: Changing the site locale can leave fallback translations stale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation cache in `translate_accelerator.rb` is keyed only by translation key, current locale, and backend. If the site default locale changes while the process is running, lookups that previously fell back to the old site locale continue returning the cached result instead of using the new fallback chain. Include the fallback configuration in the cache key or clear the translation cache when the setting changes.
